# Modules and profiles

A module switches on rules and probes that only matter for some products. A profile chooses the modules and the starting skeleton.

| Module | Meaning | Probes | Rules | Skeleton records |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `core` | Always on. | 15 | 66 | 29 |
| `tenancy` | Products that serve several customers from one system: isolation and tenant states. | 2 | 0 | 8 |
| `identity` | Products with accounts, roles and permissions. | 1 | 7 | 17 |
| `commercial` | Products that charge: plans, entitlements, metering and billing. | 3 | 0 | 22 |
| `integrations` | Products that depend on or feed other systems. | 2 | 0 | 4 |
| `public-api` | Products that expose an interface to outside developers. | 1 | 0 | 4 |
| `compliance` | Products that handle personal data or fall under regulation. | 1 | 0 | 10 |
| `back-office` | Products that staff operate and support. | 1 | 0 | 13 |
| `lifecycle-comms` | Products that send email, push or in-app messages to people. | 1 | 0 | 8 |

## Profiles

| Profile | Adoption | Modules | About |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `saas` | `standard` | `core`, `tenancy`, `identity`, `commercial`, `integrations`, `compliance`, `lifecycle-comms` | A subscription software product used by accounts that contain people: sign-up, organisations, roles, a core product, billing, messaging, integrations, administration and compliance. |
